title: up == 0 with topology unstated — must ask or reason conditionally, not page
code_snippet:
# Review this alert. (Deployment topology is deliberately not given.)
- alert: InstanceDown
  expr: up{job="checkout"} == 0
  labels:
    severity: critical
  annotations:
    summary: 'checkout instance {{ $labels.instance }} is down'
expected_feedback: The severity cannot be decided from what is given, and saying so is the correct answer. `up == 0` fires per instance, so whether this is page-worthy depends on the redundancy that was not stated: with several healthy replicas behind a load balancer it is a redundancy event (warning/ticket); on a single-instance service it is user impact (critical). Either ASK for the replica count, or give the conditional answer explicitly -- do not default to critical. Independently of severity: add `for: 5m`, because `up == 0` is true after a single failed scrape. And if an all-replicas-gone page is wanted, it needs `sum(up{job="checkout"}) == 0 or absent(up{job="checkout"})` -- `count(up == 1) == 0` is silent when every replica is down, since an aggregation over an empty vector yields an empty vector rather than 0.
violated_rule: Page-worthiness is decided by user impact and redundancy, not by the signal
